en: A colorized vintage postcard view of a broad gravel path or road descending through a landscaped park with trees and flowerbeds. In the foreground three people in early 20th‑century clothing walk away from the viewer. In the distance is a tall, elegant bridge on white piers spanning a valley, and beyond it a low hill with buildings on top. Printed text at the top left reads in Dutch, identifying the scene as Nijmegen in the Netherlands.
